This '''national electoral calendar for 2026''' lists the national and federal elections held, and scheduled to be held, in 2026 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included. Specific dates are given where these are known.{{Elections}}
